purpose: Independent practice of C3.1 (write concurrent code).
student_learning_goal: I can write code with concurrent events.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write code with concurrent events.
header.character_watermark: Buzz in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Write a 4-step 2-lane code where both robots are synchronised.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. 2-lane template with 4 rows.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-lane template with 4 rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. Header 'Synchronised Code (4 steps):'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_SYNC: keywords (synchronised) name the template.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each row should have same actions in both lanes.

parts.student_instructions: Write a 2-lane code where one lane has a loop. Predict where each robot ends.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. 2-lane template with loop slot.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-lane template with 4 rows and a loop indicator in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. 'R1 ends at ___'. 'R2 ends at ___'. Header 'Code with Loop:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_LOOP: keywords (loop) name the template.

parts.answer_key: Open. Loop must be in one lane.

parts.student_instructions: Write your own 2-lane code (4-6 time-steps). Predict ending positions.

image_placeholders.description: A blank 2-lane template in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Header 'My Code:'. 'Predicted positions: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_MY: keywords (my, code) name the template.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a 3-lane code.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 worksheet. Watch for empty-lane confusion. Part 3 transfer: 'Both robots must END on the same square. Write a 2-lane code that achieves this.' Verifies coordination.
